articles.summary: “A single Friday brought us fifteen new matters, nine of them due in court by Monday. A year ago we would have taken three of the nine, because one draft alone used to eat a full working day. With Lexi, we drafted all nine in a day.” Sahil Bansal, Partner at Bansal & Partners
